notes: The Barak's tail numbers (shared/aircraft/tail_number.gd, docs/aircraft-models.md §1.6): f16d.glb holds none (tools/f16/barak.py paints the livery's over).
notes.number: 547, the number of FlightGear's IAF livery the model wears (SOURCES.md); the sim's unit record shows the same (modern-iaf/data/db/units/f16d.json `tail`). A real Barak's, but a single-seat F-16C's (Block 40, USAF 90-0874, f-16.net): no F-16D wears it (docs/aircraft-models.md §1.6)
notes.others: the other F-16Ds in service in f-16.net's airframe database (docs/aircraft-models.md §1.6, checked 19 Nov 2026), each squadron's in number order: Ramat David's two F-16D squadrons, 105 (Block 40) then 109 (Block 30; 074 in a Commons photo there), then 612, its squadron open (f-16.net's last unit for it, 110 Squadron, closed in 2017). Not listed: written off (031, 077, 606, 621, 660) and the test centre's 020 and 601
notes.marks: where the livery's 547 was, in black: foot 0.92 m up the fin, centred 4.78 m aft (tools/f16/barak.py prints the place it paints over)
